integrity: The complete proof and independent finite symbolic consistency checker are included. Literature comparison distinguishes spatially homogeneous inertial transport from a spatially confined oscillator. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: One thermally forced, one-dimensional harmonic oscillator with exact velocity-to-zero Poisson resets; the fourth-moment statement does not establish distributional Gaussianity and is not a general partial-resetting classification.
title: A unique spatial non-Gaussianity resonance under velocity-only resetting
